public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Eden Geopower is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Paris Smalls and Ammar Alali that has raised $19.8M to date. The broader sector peer universe includes 8 private companies and 1 public comparable (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA), though no private peers operate at the same stage or valuation tier with sufficient density to support a reliable peer-median method.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, using the $19.8M total raised as a valuation proxy. This yields an implied valuation of $50M. The method is the only triangulation approach with sufficient data support; peer-median analysis is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables in the Climate & Energy sector at similar stage and scale.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, with a median point of $50M. This narrow range reflects dependence on a single method and the lack of direct peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage private comparables to validate the 2.5x multiplier and limited public market data (single public comp). Further diligence on unit economics, deployment timelines, and regulatory pathway maturity would be necessary to support material upside or downside adjustment from this range.
